plugins.name: ClickHouse
plugins.description: Read queries, write/DDL, insert records, and create-table-if-not-exists against ClickHouse over its HTTP interface, with named typed {name:Type} parameters and double-brace {{$.path}} mustache tokens pulled from the flow. Tuned for analytics workloads.
plugins.author: Inflowenger

plugins.name: GitHub (OpenConnector)
plugins.description: Read-only GitHub collector — repositories, activity, search, and the security surface (Dependabot / secret-scanning / code-scanning alerts, branch protection & rulesets, org members & 2FA, deploy keys / webhooks / Actions settings) — as a GitHub account connected centrally in FloMorphic → Connect (OpenConnector / oomol). Holds no GitHub token; uses oomol's curated actions plus its provider proxy over the flomorphic.svc.oc.* NATS subjects. The catalog's first Python -oc plugin.
plugins.author: FloMorphic

plugins.name: Gmail (OpenConnector)
plugins.description: Send, search, read, and label Gmail messages as an account connected centrally in FloMorphic → Connect (OpenConnector / oomol). Holds no Google credentials; proxies each action over the flomorphic.svc.oc.* NATS subjects.
plugins.author: FloMorphic

plugins.name: Google Workspace (OpenConnector)
plugins.description: Google Sheets, Docs, Drive, and Calendar as 30 per-operation actions grouped by product, acting as a Google account connected centrally in FloMorphic → Connect (OpenConnector / oomol). Holds no Google credentials; proxies each action over the flomorphic.svc.oc.* NATS subjects.
plugins.author: FloMorphic

plugins.name: Jira
plugins.description: Everyday Jira REST operations — create, search, transition, comment, link, log work, attach — against Jira Cloud and Server/Data Center.
plugins.author: mehdi-shokohi

plugins.name: MongoDB
plugins.description: Find, write (insert/update/delete), upsert documents, and create collections in MongoDB. Connects by URI (Compass-style), with BSON-bound JSON filters, Extended JSON, and double-brace $.path mustache tokens pulled from the flow.
plugins.author: FloMorphic

plugins.name: MySQL
plugins.description: Read, write, insert/upsert records, and create-table-if-not-exists against MySQL and MariaDB, with ?-bound parameters and double-brace {{$.path}} mustache tokens pulled from the flow. Node/TypeScript sibling of the Go Postgres plugin.
plugins.author: Inflowenger

plugins.name: Nuclei
plugins.description: Template-based vulnerability scanning with the embedded ProjectDiscovery nuclei engine — run scans, preview and search 13,000+ templates by filter, update the catalog, and validate custom templates against targets a flow provides. Active scanning, gated by per-connection safety settings.
plugins.author: Venapce

plugins.name: Playwright
plugins.description: Drive a real Chromium, Firefox or WebKit browser from a flow — open and scrape JavaScript-rendered pages, screenshot, print to PDF, evaluate scripts, and run a scripted or recorded browser session as one node.
plugins.author: Venapce

plugins.name: Postgres
plugins.description: Read, write, and create-table-if-not-exists against PostgreSQL, with $1-bound parameters and double-brace $.path mustache tokens pulled from the flow.
plugins.author: FloMorphic

plugins.name: Qdrant
plugins.description: Vector search and collection management on Qdrant — create/list collections, upsert points, nearest-neighbour search, retrieve, scroll, and delete. Talks directly to Qdrant's REST API and can embed plain text via OpenAI, Gemini, Cohere, or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
plugins.author: Inflowenger

plugins.name: Scrapli
plugins.description: Run CLI commands and push configuration to network devices — Cisco IOS-XE / NX-OS / IOS-XR, Arista EOS, Juniper JunOS — over SSH/Telnet via scrapli, with optional TextFSM (ntc-templates) parsing. The catalog's first Python-SDK plugin.
plugins.author: Inflowenger

plugins.name: Telegram (OpenConnector)
plugins.description: Send messages, photos and documents, and read updates and chats, as a Telegram bot connected centrally in FloMorphic → Connect (OpenConnector / oomol). Holds no Telegram bot token; proxies each action over the flomorphic.svc.oc.* NATS subjects.
plugins.author: mehdi-shokohi
